name: mercari
description: Estimate-only fee profile for a US Mercari seller. Copy and edit this file; nothing platform-specific is hard-coded.
notes: Mercari's seller fee is 10% of the item price. As of recent policy, the buyer pays a processing fee rather than the seller; if that changes back, add it to final_value_fee.
disclaimer: Fee rates change often. This file is an editable pattern, not official data; check Mercari's seller help pages.
